A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same IsoCLIP paper, with 23 readable pages including supplementary Sections A–I. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support comparison of all text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: V1 reports original image-to-image retrieval, text-to-text retrieval, classification, latency, and ablation results in Section 5 and the supplementary material.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–4 and supplementary experiments in Sections B–G.

M1.justification: The spectral decomposition, middle-band selection, projector alignment, and retrieval procedures are unchanged. The nonlinear-head extension in Appendix D and Algorithms 1–3 are also identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same image-retrieval, caption-retrieval, and classification datasets. Dogs vs. Cats, Places365, and iNaturalist evaluations are already present in v1 and remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including standard CLIP similarities, OTI, OVI, NCM, pre-projection features, projector whitening, and the DINOv2 comparison in Appendix F.3.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, retrieval galleries and queries, metrics, backbones, inversion budgets, and spectral-band selection protocols are unchanged in Section 5.1 and Appendices E–G.

E4.justification: Both versions retain identical spectral-band analyses, Dogs vs. Cats analysis, pre-projection and whitening ablations, OVI pseudo-patch ablation, and hyperparameter sensitivity plots. No analytical experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Section 5.1 retains the same 20-run latency averaging statement, and Tables 1–2 retain identical accompanying ± values. No repeated-run, uncertainty, or significance-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical scores, result entries, plotted findings, and prose findings are unchanged throughout both PDFs. Actual rankings implied by the scores are unchanged; corrections to bold and underlined ranking highlights are presentation changes assessed under P2.

T1.justification: The operator definitions, spectral formulation, gradient derivations, and nonlinear-head approximation are unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendices A, B, and D.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about intra-modal misalignment, the shared middle-band subspace, and efficient training-free projector alignment.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spectral anisotropy and retrieval improvements are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitations concerning inter-modal degradation and empirical band selection, including Appendix H.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, selected hyperparameters, pseudocode, and the code-access statement and link are unchanged. Appendix E.2 only corrects quotation-mark punctuation around the existing OTI template.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 58 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 corrects the opening quotation mark around 'a photo of' in Appendix E.2 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Paragraph wording, terminology, and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 1, 4, and S9 revise selected bold and underlined score highlights without changing values or table structure. For example, Table 4 now bolds the pre-projection baseline's EuroSAT 61.7 instead of IsoCLIP's 61.6; Table S9 now bolds the ViT-B/32 pre-projection UCF101 score of 49.7. Figures and overall layout are unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 makes a limited presentation improvement by correcting several misleading best/runner-up highlights in Tables 1, 4, and S9, helping readers interpret the unchanged scores accurately. The scientific content, evidence, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so the improvement is modest.
